name: loopfinder
description: Find the feedback loops in your workspace: trace your scripts with writes blocked, add the human/AI steps, and see every loop, including the ones you never declared.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, loopfinder only shows a graph that is already built. Init and build are off: building runs the workspace's scripts.

commands.title: Build the graph (runs the traced scripts)
Copy the request for your AI agent

loopfinder.allowNetwork.markdownDescription: Let traced scripts reach the network. It is always recorded; blocked by default, so the script sees an error.

loopfinder.allowSubprocess.markdownDescription: Let traced scripts start other programs. Blocked by default.

loopfinder.layoutBudget.markdownDescription: Seconds spent searching each flow's layout during a build.
